subject: Notice of Commencement of Chapter 11 Case and Claims Bar Date
text:
PLEASE TAKE NOTICE that on October 28, 2026, Harmon Steel Holdings filed a voluntary petition under Chapter 11. If you believe you hold a claim against the Debtors, you must file a proof of claim by January 15, 2027.

Do not send payments or claims to the Clerk of Court.
